EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Thank you so much for your help
recently,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} you gave me really did
the trick!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}I wanted to show you how grateful
I am,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}so I'm sending you a little gift
in the mail soon!{{TAG:0003:0026:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ti sono molto grata{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} per il tuo aiuto,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} che mi hai dato
ha funzionato!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Per dimostrarti la mia gratitudine,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}ti manderò un regalino.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Ti arriverà presto per posta!{{TAG:0003:0026:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Danke für deine Hilfe neulich,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} Die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} hat mir
sehr geholfen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich habe dir auch ein kleines
Geschenk geschickt,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} also behalte

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Thank you for worrying about me!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}When you catch a cold and feel
terrible,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hearing kind words really
lifts your spirits.
Also,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} thanks for bringing me that
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I put all of my gratitude in a letter,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
so look for it in your mailbox soon!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Muchísimas gracias por cuidarme!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Cuando coges un resfriado y te
sientes fatal,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} siempre viene bien
escuchar palabras bonitas.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}¡Ah!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Esto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡y la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}también
viene muy bien, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}claro!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}He puesto toda mi gratitud en una
carta,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¡así que no te olvides de
mirar en tu buzón!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Merci beaucoup de t'être occup{{TAG:000E:0006:0200E9000400E9006500}}
de moi quand j'avais ce rhume
carabiné !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Quand on est patraque, ça met du
baume au cœur de recevoir la visite
{{TAG:000E:0006:10006400270075006E00200061006D00690014006400270075006E006500200061006D0069006500}}.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Et surtout, merci de m'avoir
apporté ce {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tu vas bientôt recevoir dans ta
boîte aux lettres un « merci » qui
vient directement du cœur !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sei stat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} molto gentile
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}a preoccuparti per me!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Quando hai il raffreddore e ti senti
a pezzi,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} delle parole affettuose{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
aiutano a stare subito meglio.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Vorrei ringraziarti{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} anche per
la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} che mi hai dato{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ti ho scritto tutto quello che sento
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}in una lettera.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} La troverai presto
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}nella cassetta delle lettere!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Danke, dass du dir Sorgen um
mich gemacht hast!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenn man krank ist und sich
schlecht fühlt, ist es doch schön,
wenn jemand Anteil nimmt.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Und die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}hat natürlich auch
geholfen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Ich habe dir auch schon
einen Dankesbrief geschrieben!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Benim için endişelendiğin için teşekkür
ederim!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} İnsan nezle olup perişan
hissedince,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} birkaç güzel söz bile
moralini yükseltiyor. Bir de{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} getirdiğin
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ilaç{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} için teşekkürler{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Minnettarlığımı

bakmayı unutma!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}My cold is
completely better!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} you gave me
really did the trick, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The fact that I can enjoy life again
is all thanks to you!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Oh, before I forget! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}I've sent you a
thank-you present,{{TAG:0003:0001:}} and I hope you
enjoy it!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ! Tu te souviens du
vilain rhume que j'avais attrapé ?
C'est de l'histoire ancienne !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Et ce, grâce à toi et à ton super
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ! {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Je me sens renaître,
merci beaucoup, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}D'ailleurs, je t'ai envoyé un petit
cadeau pour te remercier ! J'espère
que ça te fera plaisir !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Il mio raffreddore
è completamente svanito!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} che mi hai dato{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
ha funzionato subito, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Per merito tuo{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} ora posso tornare
a divertirmi come e più di prima!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Oh, prima che mi dimentichi! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ti ho
spedito un regalo per ringraziarti.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spero che ti piaccia!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Merkst du was?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Meine Erkältung ist schon wieder
ganz weg!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, die du mir gebracht
hast, hat wirklich gut geholfen,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich fühle mich wieder richtig gut,
und das habe ich allein dir zu
verdanken!
Darum habe ich dir auch ein kleines
Geschenk geschickt –{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} hoffentlich
gefällt es dir!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Aa,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Nezlem tamamen geçti!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}
Verdiğin {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ilaç{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} gerçekten işe yaradı,
